It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 10 April 2026. The set consists of 37 virtual cards.
Venture deeper into the Delta Quadrant than ever before with '''To the Journey''', a brand new virtual First Edition expansion. Featuring 37 unique cards, all focused on the Delta Quadrant, this set includes 29 new missions for all your favorite Delta Quadrant decks! But beware rampaging Borg, an entire Star Desert, and enemy facilities everywhere.
